decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007960 was posted on 2026-10-07 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, which is 15 days later. The limit is 120 days. The posted amount is 4392 cents (43.92 EUR). The authorisation AUTH-008163 was approved for 4105 cents (41.05 EUR). It was a contactless payment with no fraud flag. Meadowlark Bistro (MER-000011) is a RESTAURANT merchant. No receipt is attached, and the 41.05 EUR bill amount comes only from the cardholder's statement. The posted amount is 287 cents above the authorised amount. 20% of the authorised amount is 821 cents. A 287-cent difference is within the restaurant tip tolerance, so policy treats it as an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch. The dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Meadowlark Bistro is a restaurant. You were charged 2.87 EUR more than the 41.05 EUR authorised at payment. Restaurants may add a tip of up to 20% of the authorised amount when the charge is posted, so this difference is treated as a tip, not an incorrect charge.
